packageRules.description: The stitch runtime's node floor is >=22.12 (set by puppeteer-core 25.5); Babel 8 requires >=22.18. Block @babel/* majors until the floor is deliberately raised past 22.18 (see PRs #720/#722).

browser-use hard-pins click (==8.3.1 through 0.13.8, ==8.3.3 from 0.13.9), so the smoke-agent group makes any higher click unresolvable in configs/claude/uv.lock. Cap click until browser-use unpins (see PR #930).

uv is pinned in config/toolchain.lock.json, bootstrap/lib/verified_uv.sh (with per-target digests), and every setup-uv `version:` of a toolchain-provisioning job; on GRF the uv release decides the attested managed-CPython provider. Renovate can only bump the workflow copies, which fails tests/python/test_uv_pin_coherence.py. Require dashboard approval and bump all three by hand, then re-attest.
